servers.name: Filesystem
servers.description: Read, search and edit files inside the directories you allow.

user_args.description: Directories the server may access (absolute paths).

servers.name: Memory (knowledge graph)
servers.description: Persistent local knowledge graph agents can share across sessions.

servers.name: GitHub
servers.description: Issues, pull requests, code search and repository management (GitHub's hosted server).

secrets.name: github-pat
secrets.description: GitHub personal access token (fine-grained, only the repos you need).
secrets.format_hint: github_pat_… (fine-grained, recommended) or a classic token

servers.notes: Write tools (create/update/push/delete) ask by default and merges need a human every time. Lockdown mode (X-MCP-Lockdown) hides public-repository content from people without push access, which blunts prompt injection through issues and comments. `*_read` also matches mark_all_notifications_read, which the `mark_*` rule keeps on ask.

servers.name: GitHub (local Docker)
servers.description: GitHub's official MCP server run locally in Docker from a pinned image digest.

secrets.name: github-pat
secrets.description: GitHub personal access token (fine-grained, only the repos you need).
secrets.format_hint: github_pat_… (fine-grained, recommended) or a classic token

servers.notes: Same tools as the hosted server, run on your machine. The image is pinned to v1.12.2 by digest; update the digest to upgrade. For GitHub Enterprise Server add GITHUB_HOST to env (and `-e GITHUB_HOST` to args) in mcp.yaml.

servers.name: GitLab
servers.description: Issues, merge requests, pipelines and search on GitLab.com or your own instance (GitLab's built-in server).
servers.notes: Beta; Premium and Ultimate. Sign in with `foreman mcp login gitlab` (OAuth with dynamic client registration, `mcp` scope). Self-managed instances can turn dynamic client registration off; use gitlab-community there.

servers.name: GitLab (community, token)
servers.description: GitLab projects, issues, merge requests and pipelines with a personal access token; any tier, self-managed too.

secrets.name: gitlab-pat
secrets.description: GitLab personal access token (`api` scope; `read_api` is enough for read-only use).

servers.notes: Community package — review it before trusting it with write access.

servers.name: Playwright browser
servers.description: Drive a real browser: navigate, click, fill forms, take snapshots.
servers.notes: Navigation and form actions ask by default — a browser is an exfiltration channel.

servers.name: Chrome DevTools
servers.description: Inspect and debug a live Chrome: performance traces, network, console, DOM.

servers.name: Notion (hosted)
servers.description: Search, read and edit Notion pages and databases (Notion's hosted server, sign in with OAuth).
servers.notes: Sign in with `foreman mcp login notion-hosted`; access follows your own Notion permissions.

servers.name: Notion
servers.description: Search, read and edit Notion pages and databases (self-hosted server with an integration token).

secrets.name: notion-integration-token
secrets.description: Internal integration secret (share the pages you want with the integration).

servers.notes: Notion no longer maintains this local server; notion-hosted is the supported one.

servers.name: Sentry
servers.description: Errors, issues, releases and performance data from Sentry.

secrets.name: sentry-access-token
secrets.description: Sentry user auth token.

servers.name: Atlassian (Jira, Confluence)
servers.description: Jira issues and Confluence pages through Atlassian's official Rovo MCP server (Cloud, OAuth).
servers.notes: Sign in with `foreman mcp login atlassian`. An organization admin may have to allow the connection under Rovo MCP server settings. v2 lists a few primary tools and reaches the rest through discover / executeRead / executeWrite / executeDestructive; writes ask by default.

servers.name: Atlassian (Jira, Confluence) — API token
servers.description: Atlassian's official Rovo MCP server with an API token instead of a browser sign-in (Cloud).

secrets.name: atlassian-mcp-basic
secrets.description: base64 of `<your Atlassian email>:<API token>` (Basic auth). `foreman integrations add atlassian` builds it for you.

servers.notes: An organization admin must enable API token authentication for the Rovo MCP server first.

servers.name: Atlassian (community, Cloud / Server / DC)
servers.description: Jira and Confluence with an API token, including Server and Data Center (sooperset/mcp-atlassian).

secrets.name: atlassian-api-token
secrets.description: Atlassian API token for that account.

servers.notes: Community package. For Server / Data Center with a personal access token, set JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN / CONFLUENCE_PERSONAL_TOKEN and the right URLs in mcp.yaml instead.

servers.name: Trello
servers.description: Boards, lists and cards through Atlassian's official Trello server (OAuth).
servers.notes: Unverified: Trello signs in through Atlassian's authorization server, which offered dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) and PKCE when checked on 2026-09-28, but a full `foreman mcp login` has not been tested yet. Tool names are not published, so every tool asks. If sign-in fails, use trello-community.

servers.name: Trello (community, API key)
servers.description: Boards, lists, cards and checklists with a Trello API key and token (delorenj/mcp-server-trello).

secrets.name: trello-api-key
secrets.description: API key of a Trello Power-Up you own.

secrets.name: trello-token
secrets.description: A user token generated for that API key.
secrets.format_hint: long token, usually starting with ATTA

servers.notes: Community package — review it before trusting it with write access.

servers.name: Linear
servers.description: Issues, projects, cycles and comments in Linear (Linear's hosted server, OAuth).
servers.notes: Sign in with `foreman mcp login linear`.

servers.name: Linear — API key
servers.description: Linear's hosted server with a personal API key instead of a browser sign-in.

secrets.name: linear-api-key
secrets.description: Linear personal API key (give it only the Read permission for read-only use).

servers.name: Stripe
servers.description: Customers, invoices, payments and subscriptions via the Stripe API.

secrets.name: stripe-restricted-key
secrets.description: A RESTRICTED key (rk_…) with only the permissions your agents need — never your full secret key.

servers.notes: Every call that creates, updates, refunds or cancels asks you first.

servers.name: Brave Search
servers.description: Private web, news, image and local search.

secrets.name: brave-api-key
secrets.description: Brave Search API key.

servers.name: Exa search
servers.description: Neural web search and page contents (hosted server, works anonymously with rate limits).
servers.notes: Add `Authorization: Bearer ${secret:exa-api-key}` under headers in mcp.yaml for higher limits.

servers.name: Firecrawl
servers.description: Scrape, crawl and extract structured data from websites.

secrets.name: firecrawl-api-key
secrets.description: Firecrawl API key.

servers.name: Context7 docs
servers.description: Up-to-date library documentation and code examples for coding agents.

servers.name: Figma (Framelink)
servers.description: Give coding agents Figma layout and styling data.

secrets.name: figma-api-key
secrets.description: Figma personal access token (read-only file scopes are enough).

servers.name: Resend email
servers.description: Send transactional email through Resend.

secrets.name: resend-api-key
secrets.description: Resend API key (sending access, one verified domain).

servers.notes: Sending email always asks — outbound email is the classic exfiltration path.

servers.name: Discord
servers.description: Read and post in Discord servers through a bot you own (moderation, community updates).

secrets.name: discord-bot-token
secrets.description: Bot token of a Discord application you created.

servers.notes: Posting, deleting and moderation actions ask by default.

servers.name: X (Twitter)
servers.description: Post tweets and search X with your own developer app keys.

secrets.name: x-api-key
secrets.description: X app API key.

secrets.name: x-api-secret
secrets.description: X app API key secret.

secrets.name: x-access-token
secrets.description: X user access token.

secrets.name: x-access-token-secret
secrets.description: X user access token secret.

servers.notes: Posting asks by default — public posts cannot be taken back.

servers.name: YouTube transcripts
servers.description: Fetch YouTube video transcripts for summarising and research.
servers.notes: Needs yt-dlp on PATH.

servers.name: App Store Connect
servers.description: Apps, builds, TestFlight, reviews and sales reports on Apple's App Store Connect.

secrets.name: asc-issuer-id
secrets.description: App Store Connect API issuer id.

secrets.name: asc-key-id
secrets.description: App Store Connect API key id.

secrets.name: asc-private-key-path
secrets.description: Absolute path to the downloaded .p8 key file.

servers.notes: Submitting builds or editing metadata asks by default.

servers.name: App Store + Google Play
servers.description: Release status, reviews and metadata across Apple App Store and Google Play in one server.

secrets.name: asc-key-id
secrets.description: App Store Connect API key id.

secrets.name: asc-issuer-id
secrets.description: App Store Connect API issuer id.

secrets.name: asc-private-key-path
secrets.description: Absolute path to the .p8 key file.

secrets.name: play-service-account-path
secrets.description: Absolute path to a Google Play service-account JSON.

servers.notes: Community package — review it before trusting it with release rights.
